从教师办公室的后门出来，一直走到快到走廊的尽头，才终于到达了校长办公室唯一的门。

同样黑漆漆的，没有窗户的房间。

房门打开的瞬间，一股陈旧阴湿的发霉味道扑鼻而来。

靳兰玦脚下停顿一瞬，周玉已经在身后叫出来：“好臭！”

入目是一张塌软的布沙发，木头茶几。

左手边的办公桌是黑色的老样式，后面的墙壁上挂着字幅，上书【宁静致远】。

进门右手边的整面墙壁都是贴墙的书架，里面的书籍摆放按照种类分格。

每一格里面的书又按照从低到高摆放，十分整齐。

靳兰玦叉腰站在书柜前，啧啧有声：

“这个校长……”

【强迫症表示极度舒适】

【哇！这书架的摆书方式跟我家的一模一样！】

靳兰玦明明看到了弹幕，还继续把感慨的话说完了：

“一般这样极度强迫症的性格里面，很容易出变态的。”

【？？？】

无数问号刷屏飘过去，靳兰玦已经转身走向了办公桌。

桌上的文件框固定在桌子一角，一旁是紧贴着文具箱。

不论是文件还是文具，全部摆放得整整齐齐，比商场里的样板间摆放得更加工整刻板。

周玉嘀嘀咕咕：“这是活人会用的办公室吗？太恐怖了吧，我要是跟这种人在一个办公室里面……”

靳兰玦接话：“那你早就凉凉了。”

周玉：“……”

靳兰玦带着问题来找答案，寻找线索的效果十分明显。

一无所获。

校长办公室里面干干净净，没有人使用过的痕迹，所有文件看上去都中规中矩没有任何问题。

周玉转头去看书柜：

“难道在那些书里面？

嘶……这么多，不太好找吧……”

靳兰玦沉吟片刻，转身离开：“我们先下楼与同伴汇合，交流一下情报。”

二楼的收获也十分喜人。

女孩儿宿舍里面有一面玩具黑板，起初紧贴墙壁放着，上面用粉笔画着小孩子稚嫩的涂鸦。

苏怀瑾与吴毅安两人，谁也没有将这个黑板放在心上。

He walked out of the back door of the teacher's office and walked almost to the end of the corridor before finally reaching the only door of the principal's office.

The same dark, windowless room.

The moment the door opened, an old, damp, musty smell hit my nostrils.

Jin Lanjue paused for a moment, and Zhou Yu shouted from behind: "It stinks!"

What you see is a soft cloth sofa and a wooden coffee table.

The desk on the left is an old-style black one, with a banner hanging on the wall behind it that reads "Peace and Peace".

The entire wall on the right side of the entrance is lined with bookshelves, and the books inside are arranged according to categories.

The books in each grid are arranged from low to high, very neatly.

Jin Lanjue stood in front of the bookcase with her hands on her hips and clicked her tongue:

"This principal..."

[Obsessive-compulsive disorder means extreme comfort]

【Wow!The way the books are arranged on this bookshelf is exactly the same as the one at my house!】

Jin Lanjue clearly saw the barrage and continued to finish his emotional words:

"Generally, it's easy for someone with such an extremely obsessive-compulsive personality to become perverted."

【???】

Countless question marks floated across the screen, and Jin Lanjue turned around and walked towards his desk.

The file frame on the table is fixed on the corner of the table, and the stationery box is close to the side.

Whether it is documents or stationery, they are all neatly arranged, more neatly arranged than the model rooms in shopping malls.

Zhou Yu muttered: "Is this an office that a living person would use? It's too scary. If I were in an office with such a person..."

Jin Lanjue answered: "Then you would have been cold by now."

Zhou Yu: "..."

Jin Lanjue brought questions to find answers, and the effect of searching for clues was very obvious.

Nothing was found.

The principal's office was clean, with no trace of use, and all the documents looked in order and without any problems.

Zhou Yu turned to look at the bookcase:

"Is it in those books?

Hiss… there are so many, it’s hard to find…”

Jin Lanjue pondered for a moment, then turned and left: "Let's go downstairs to meet up with our companions and exchange information."

The harvest on the second floor is also very gratifying.

There was a toy blackboard in the girls' dormitory, which was originally placed close to the wall, with childish graffiti drawn in chalk on it.

Neither Su Huaijin nor Wu Yian took this blackboard to heart.
